description: This file defines a base class for strategies that detect when a user starts speaking in a turn-based interaction system. It includes event handling, configuration parameters, and lifecycle methods for setup, cleanup, and processing frames.

classes.name: UserTurnStartedParams
classes.description: Parameters emitted when a user turn starts, indicating whether to enable interruptions and user speaking frames.

classes.name: BaseUserTurnStartStrategy
classes.description: Abstract base class for strategies that determine when a user starts speaking, with event handling and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with optional interruption and speaking frame settings.

methods.name: task_manager
methods.description: Property that returns the configured task manager or raises an error if not set.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Associates a task manager with the strategy.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the strategy.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the strategy to its initial state.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame; meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: push_frame
methods.description: Emits an event to push a frame downstream.

methods.name: broadcast_frame
methods.description: Emits an event to broadcast a frame of a specified class.

methods.name: trigger_user_turn_started
methods.description: Triggers the event indicating a user turn has started, passing relevant parameters.
